faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PCCF HoFF Assam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the PCCF HoFF Assam Recruitment 2026 is 21st September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for the posts of Computer Assistant and GIS Analyst in the Principal Chief Conservator of Forests and Head of Forest Force, Assam recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Computer Assistant post?
faq.answer: For the Computer Assistant position, candidates need to have a Graduation in any discipline along with a One-year Diploma in Computer Application from a recognized institution and 5 years of work experience in the Forestry sector.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification for the GIS Analyst post?
faq.answer: The eligibility criteria for the GIS Analyst post include a Master's degree in GIS and Remote Sensing, along with a minimum of 5 years of experience working with spatial software like ArcGIS or QGIS.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The age limit for all posts under this recruitment is between 21 years and 40 years. Specific age relaxations, if any, are not detailed in the provided information.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Computer Assistant and GIS Analyst positions?
faq.answer: Both the Computer Assistant and GIS Analyst positions offer a fixed monthly salary of Rs. 40,000/-.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for the PCCF HoFF Assam Recruitment 2026 are to be submitted via email. Candidates need to send their complete application along with necessary documents to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category of candidates applying for the PCCF HoFF Assam Recruitment 2026. The application is free of cost.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these government jobs?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Computer Assistant and GIS Analyst posts in PCCF HoFF Assam will be based on an Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience.
